Markus / Laura —

I sketched a short "signal bridge" reconciliation method in the Drive doc (link above). TL;DR: treat three signal buckets independently — Contribution (impact), Craft (skill quality), Scope (role breadth). For each divergent pair we:

1) Normalize each signal to the role-specific baseline (last 3 cycles)
2) Identify signal deltas > 0.6 stdev as "material"
3) If Contribution >> Craft (delta pattern A) biased toward promotion band; if Craft >> Contribution (delta pattern B) biased toward growth-plan band
4) For ambiguous cases, default to median of the matched peer group and flag for 2-up review

I'll run this algorithm over the six anchors and post a short table before the session. Also: I propose we keep the session to 45 min (20 min anchors, 15 min comparisons, 10 min decisions). If we hit more than 5 outliers, we escalate to an asynchronous adjudication step.

Vivek
